intro: Our Suez sofa turns any corner into a cosy retreat. With its elegant tufted backrest, broad armrests, and high ground clearance, it’s your stylish addition for spaces that demand comfort and charm.

features.title: Elegant tufted backrest design
features.text: The tufted backrest adds a touch of refined luxury, elevating your space with sophisticated charm and lasting comfort.

features.title: Premium finish, effortless maintenance
features.text: Upholstered in breathable, easy-to-maintain leatherette, it offers a sleek look with effortless upkeep—perfect for modern living.

features.title: Shape it your way every day
features.text: The versatile L-shaped modular design gives you the flexibility to arrange your space for lounging, hosting, or simply stretching out in comfort.

features.title: Extra space for extra special moments
features.text: Generous seating ensures maximum comfort, making it the perfect spot to gather, unwind, or enjoy a quiet moment.

features.title: Comfort that goes the extra mile
features.text: Wide, supportive armrests provide a cozy place to rest, making every seat feel like the best seat in the house.

features.title: Smart design, effortless upkeep
features.text: With high ground clearance, cleaning underneath is quick and easy, so your space stays fresh with minimal effort.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
